name: GRILL
summary: Relentless alignment interview before any task: surfaces every ambiguity, decision branch, and unstated assumption before a single line of code is written.
prevents: Misaligned output — building something technically correct that isn't what the user actually wanted.

cursor.rule_description: Use at the start of any non-trivial task, feature, or design decision where the requirement is ambiguous, broad, or has unstated assumptions.
cursor.skill_description: agentgrammar GRILL — relentless alignment interview that resolves every decision branch before coding starts. Use when the user invokes /agentgrammar-grill-me or starts a task with unclear requirements.
